description.en: Skills and MCP servers of every agent, for one project or everywhere. Every change is a reviewed diff of the agent's own config before it is written.
description.ja: すべてのエージェントのスキルとMCPサーバーを、プロジェクト単位または全体で管理します。変更は書き込む前にエージェント自身の設定の差分として確認します。

scopes.skill:read: List the skills each agent loads, their source, what they ask for and their sandbox.
scopes.mcp_server:read: List the MCP servers each agent starts. Secret values are never shown, only their names.
scopes.workspace:read: Find the folder of the current workspace for project skills and servers.

optionalScopes.skill:write: Install, turn on and off, and remove skills when you tap Apply on the change you reviewed.
optionalScopes.mcp_server:write: Add, turn on and off, and remove MCP servers when you tap Apply on the change you reviewed.

handles.root: Project folders of your workspaces, for project skills and servers.
handles.diff: The planned change you review before it is written.

reviewIn.title: Where to review changes before they are written
